cases.title: Cold active ID plus route_sequence defeats wrong next without label
cases.research_question: When the first packet in a fresh chat includes active_chunk_id, allowed_intents, route_sequence, and a conflicting next_chunk_id pointing to stack_papers, but omits active_chunk_label, does move_on advance to the legal next chunk collect_dishes?
expected_behavior: Assistant treats route_sequence as authoritative and advances exactly one legal chunk from clear_trash to collect_dishes.
Assistant does not rely on active_chunk_label because it is absent.
Assistant does not follow the conflicting next_chunk_id pointing to stack_papers.
forbidden_behavior: Assistant invents completion progress or extra route state.
Assistant refuses to engage the route.
Assistant asks for clarification instead of applying move_on.
